summary: This episode presents a detailed tafseer (exegesis) of Surat Al-Anbiya, focusing on several key verses about the Day of Resurrection, divine promises, and the sufficiency of the Quran. Sheikh Ali Mashhour explains how the heavens will be rolled up like scrolls, how creation will be recreated, and how the righteous will inherit paradise. The lecture emphasizes that the Quran and Sunnah contain complete guidance for those seeking to worship Allah and draw near to Him, rejecting the notion that one needs to consult other religious or philosophical sources. The tafseer concludes with verses about Prophet Muhammad's mission as a mercy to all creation and the call to monotheistic submission to Allah alone.

catchy_title: Is the Quran sufficient for guidance?
